about: 24 questions, 12 per Act, written from the two Acts' own sections: the Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019 (8 sections) and the Prevention of Damage to Public Property Act, 1984 (7). AI-marked, NOT a lawyer's list: 'expected' = the section(s) Claude judges answer the question; 'also_ok' = other sections that would be a reasonable first look. 'hard' = Claude expected retrieval to struggle (a guess made before the run). PD12 is hard on purpose: section 6 of the Public Property Act is a 'Saving' section, which the shelf never ranks by meaning (housekeeping rule), so it is reached only when a question names it by number. Never edit a question after a run to improve a score; a mistake in the key is corrected only with a note in 'corrections_log'.
